findings.claim: Setting extra=forbid on FileMatchingRequest, and reusing the shared normalisers in drives.py, reaches every existing caller of POST /files/matching and of apply_file_filters beyond the intelligence addon fetch.
findings.impact: Any other client that sends an extra key to /files/matching now gets 422. The spec asserts that only fetch_matching_file_ids calls it and I did not verify that. The new drive parameter of apply_file_filters is optional, so an unlisted caller that passes collections without a drive would raise ValueError, a 500.
findings.evidence: backend/app/routers/internal.py adds ConfigDict(extra='forbid'). drives.py apply_file_filters raises ValueError when collections is given and drive is None. The grep found only drives.py and internal.py as backend callers.
